description: A utility class providing methods to generate test responses with proper ETag headers for various 'thing' related operations within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating mock responses for retrieving, modifying, and querying 'things' and their associated components such as features, attributes, ACLs, policies, and definitions, primarily for testing purposes.

classes.name: ETagTestUtils
classes.description: A utility class with static methods for constructing test responses containing appropriate ETag headers for different 'thing' components, used to facilitate testing of versioning and concurrency control.

methods.name: retrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a mock RetrieveThingResponse for a given Thing, including an ETag header based on the Thing's entity ID and JSON representation.

methods.name: retrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a mock RetrieveThingResponse for a given Thing with headers, including an ETag based on the Thing's entity ID and its JSON string.

methods.name: modifyThingResponse
methods.description: Constructs a ModifyThingResponse indicating a modified 'Thing', updating the revision and including an ETag header.

methods.name: sudoRetrieveThingResponse
methods.description: Creates a SudoRetrieveThingResponse for testing, including ETag headers.

methods.name: modifyFeaturesResponse
methods.description: Generates a response for feature modification, indicating creation or update, with appropriate ETag headers.

methods.name: retrieveFeaturesResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response containing retrieved features and their ETag headers.

methods.name: retrieveFeatureResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response with a specific feature and its ETag.

methods.name: modifyFeatureResponse
methods.description: Creates a response indicating a feature was created or modified, with ETag headers.

methods.name: modifyFeatureDefinitionResponse
methods.description: Builds a response for feature definition modifications, with ETag.

methods.name: retrieveFeatureDefinitionResponse
methods.description: Creates a response containing a feature definition and ETag.

methods.name: modifyFeaturePropertiesResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response for feature properties modifications with ETag headers.

methods.name: retrieveFeaturePropertiesResponse
methods.description: Builds a response for retrieving feature properties, includes ETag.

methods.name: retrieveFeaturePropertyResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response for a single feature property, including ETag.

methods.name: modifyAttributesResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for attribute modifications, with ETag.

methods.name: retrieveAttributesResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response with attributes and their ETag.

methods.name: modifyAttributeResponse
methods.description: Builds a response for a single attribute modification, including ETag.

methods.name: retrieveAttributeResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for retrieving a specific attribute with ETag.

methods.name: modifyAclResponse
methods.description: Builds a response for ACL modifications with ETag.

methods.name: retrieveAclResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response for retrieving ACLs, including ETag.

methods.name: modifyAclEntryResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for ACL entry modifications with ETag.

methods.name: retrieveAclEntryResponse
methods.description: Builds a response for retrieving an ACL entry with ETag.

methods.name: modifyPolicyIdResponse
methods.description: Constructs a response for policy ID modification, includes ETag.

methods.name: retrievePolicyIdResponse
methods.description: Creates a response for retrieving a policy ID with ETag.

methods.name: modifyThingDefinitionResponse
methods.description: Builds a response for ThingDefinition modifications, with ETag.

methods.name: retrieveDefinitionResponse
methods.description: Creates a response containing ThingDefinition and ETag.

methods.name: appendETagToDittoHeaders
methods.description: A helper method to append an ETag to DittoHeaders based on the provided object.
